EXCLUSIVE DISTRIBUTORSHIP AGREEMENT

THIS EXCLUSIVE DISTRIBUTORSHIP AGREEMENT ("Agreement") is made at Mumbai on this 1st day of April 2026 ("Effective Date")

BETWEEN

AMRUTAM CONSUMER BRANDS PRIVATE LIMITED, a company incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013, having CIN U15490MH2011PTC123456 and its registered office at 7th Floor, Raheja Business Arcade, Lower Parel, Mumbai 400013, Maharashtra, hereinafter referred to as the "COMPANY" (which expression shall include its successors and assigns) of the ONE PART;

AND

MEHTA TRADING CO., a partnership firm registered under the Indian Partnership Act, 1932, bearing GSTIN 24ABCDE1234F1Z5, having its principal place of business at 22, Gondal Road, Rajkot 360002, Gujarat, through its Managing Partner Mr. Jayesh Harshadbhai Mehta, hereinafter referred to as the "DISTRIBUTOR" (which expression shall include its partners, successors and permitted assigns) of the OTHER PART.

RECITALS

A. The Company manufactures and markets packaged food and beverage products under the brand "AMRUTAM" (the "Brand") and the other brands listed in Schedule 1 (the "Products").

B. The Distributor has experience in the distribution of fast-moving consumer goods in Gujarat and has represented that it has the infrastructure, warehousing and working capital necessary to distribute the Products.

C. The Company wishes to appoint the Distributor as its exclusive distributor for the Territory, and the Distributor wishes to accept such appointment, on the terms of this Agreement.

1. DEFINITIONS

1.1 "Territory" means the State of Gujarat, India.

1.2 "Contract Year" means each period of twelve (12) months commencing on 1 April and ending on 31 March, the first Contract Year being 1 April 2026 to 31 March 2027.

1.3 "Minimum Annual Commitment" has the meaning given in Clause 5.1.

1.4 "Price List" means the Company's distributor price list, as revised from time to time.

2. APPOINTMENT AND EXCLUSIVITY

2.1 The Company hereby appoints the Distributor as its exclusive distributor of the Products in the Territory for the Term, and the Distributor accepts such appointment.

2.2 The Company shall not appoint any other distributor for the Territory for the Term. Notwithstanding the foregoing, the Company reserves the right (a) to sell the Products directly to modern trade chains, institutional buyers, canteens and e-commerce platforms in the Territory, and (b) to sell the Products through any online channel, in each case without any obligation to the Distributor.

2.3 The Distributor shall not, directly or indirectly, sell or distribute outside the Territory, and shall not, during the Term and for a period of two (2) years thereafter, distribute, market or deal in any product which competes with any of the Products anywhere in India.

3. TERM

3.1 This Agreement shall commence on the Effective Date and, subject to earlier termination in accordance with Clause 11, shall continue for five (5) years, till 31 March 2031 (the "Term").

3.2 The Term shall be renewed automatically for further periods of five (5) years unless the Company gives notice of non-renewal. The Distributor shall have no right of non-renewal.

4. ORDERS, PRICE AND PAYMENT

4.1 The Distributor shall place orders for the Products in writing and the Company shall supply them subject to availability. The Company shall not be liable for any failure or delay in supply.

4.2 The Products shall be sold to the Distributor at the prices in the Price List, which the Company may revise at any time without notice. Orders accepted by the Company shall be invoiced at the prices prevailing on the date of dispatch.

4.3 The Distributor shall pay for each consignment in advance, by RTGS, before dispatch. Where the Company in its discretion extends credit, such credit shall not exceed seven (7) days from the date of invoice and shall carry interest at twenty-four per cent (24%) per annum after the due date.

4.4 The Distributor shall maintain a refundable security deposit of Rs 15,00,000/- (Rupees Fifteen Lakh only) with the Company throughout the Term, without interest. The Company may adjust any amounts it claims against such deposit, and the balance shall be refunded within one hundred and eighty (180) days of the termination of this Agreement.

4.5 All taxes under the Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 and the Gujarat Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 shall be charged as applicable. The Company shall issue invoices in compliance with the provisions of the said Acts, and the Distributor shall be entitled to input tax credit subject to the Company having uploaded the invoices to the GST portal and paid the tax thereon.

5. MINIMUM PURCHASE COMMITMENT

5.1 The Distributor shall purchase from the Company Products of a net invoice value (excluding GST) of not less than Rs 2,00,00,000/- (Rupees Two Crore only) in each Contract Year (the "Minimum Annual Commitment"). The Minimum Annual Commitment shall be increased by ten per cent (10%) for each subsequent Contract Year.

5.2 If in any Contract Year the Distributor's purchases fall short of the Minimum Annual Commitment, the Distributor shall pay to the Company, within fifteen (15) days of a demand, a sum equal to thirty per cent (30%) of the shortfall as liquidated damages, irrespective of whether the Company has suffered any loss, and the Company may in addition terminate this Agreement under Clause 11.2.

5.3 The Minimum Annual Commitment shall not be reduced on account of any failure or delay by the Company in supplying the Products, stock-outs, product recalls, regulatory action, market disruption, force majeure, or the Company's sales under Clause 2.2.

6. DISTRIBUTOR'S OBLIGATIONS

6.1 The Distributor shall at its own cost maintain a godown of at least 5,000 square feet with fire safety and FSSAI-compliant storage, a fleet of not less than four (4) delivery vehicles, and not less than twelve (12) salesmen and two (2) supervisors, and shall appoint sub-distributors and retailers to ensure coverage of at least 8,000 retail outlets in the Territory.

6.2 The Distributor shall hold all licences and registrations required for its operations, including the FSSAI licence under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and registration under the GST laws.

6.3 The Distributor shall comply with the Company's sales policy, price lists, schemes and merchandising guidelines as amended from time to time. The Distributor shall bear the entire cost of trade schemes, discounts and promotions that the Company may mandate.

7. STOCK, RETURNS AND SHELF LIFE

7.1 Title to and risk in the Products shall pass to the Distributor on delivery at the Company's depot.

7.2 All Products sold to the Distributor are sold on a non-returnable basis. The Company shall not accept the return of, or give any credit or refund for, any unsold, slow-moving, near-expiry, expired, damaged or seasonal stock, or any stock remaining on termination or expiry of this Agreement, regardless of the cause.

7.3 On the termination or expiry of this Agreement, the Distributor shall not sell the unsold stock to any other person other than the Company's nominee, who shall purchase it, if at all, at a price determined by the Company at a discount of not less than forty per cent (40%) to the Price List.

8. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY

8.1 The Distributor acknowledges that the Company is the owner of the Brand and all trade marks registered under the Trade Marks Act, 1999 in respect of the Products. The Distributor shall use the Brand only in the manner approved by the Company, and any goodwill arising from such use shall accrue to the Company.

8.2 The Distributor shall not register or apply for registration of any trade mark, domain name or social media handle containing the Brand or any deceptively similar mark.

9. WARRANTY AND LIABILITY

9.1 The Company gives no warranty regarding the Products, their quality or their fitness for any purpose, and the Distributor shall be solely responsible for any claim made by any consumer, retailer, regulator or any person in respect of the Products after delivery, including any claim under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019 or the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, even if such claim arises from a manufacturing defect.

9.2 The Distributor shall indemnify the Company against all claims, losses, costs and expenses, without limit, arising from any act or omission of the Distributor, its employees, sub-distributors or retailers. The aggregate liability of the Company to the Distributor under this Agreement shall not exceed Rs 1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lakh only).

10. RECORDS AND AUDIT

10.1 The Distributor shall maintain accurate records of purchases, sales, stock and retailers, and shall allow the Company to audit its premises, books and systems at any time on twenty-four (24) hours' notice, and shall provide daily stock and sales reports in the format specified by the Company.

11. TERMINATION

11.1 The Company may terminate this Agreement at any time, for convenience and without assigning any reason, by giving thirty (30) days' written notice to the Distributor, and shall not be liable to pay any compensation, goodwill or damages on account of such termination, or for any investment made by the Distributor.

11.2 The Company may terminate this Agreement forthwith by written notice if the Distributor (a) commits any breach of this Agreement, (b) fails to meet the Minimum Annual Commitment in any Contract Year, or (c) is in the Company's opinion likely to damage the Brand.

11.3 The Distributor shall not be entitled to terminate this Agreement for any reason during the first three (3) years of the Term, i.e. before 1 April 2029. After that date the Distributor may terminate by giving one hundred and eighty (180) days' written notice, provided that it has paid all sums due to the Company and has met the Minimum Annual Commitment for each Contract Year up to the date of termination.

11.4 On termination or expiry, the Distributor shall cease to hold itself out as a distributor of the Company, and Clause 7.3 and Clause 2.3 shall continue to apply.

12. DISPUTE RESOLUTION

12.1 This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of India. Any dispute shall be referred to a sole arbitrator nominated by the Managing Director of the Company, under the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996. The seat and venue shall be Mumbai.

12.2 The courts at Mumbai shall have exclusive jurisdiction for the purposes of Clause 12.1 and for any interim relief.

13. GENERAL

13.1 The relationship between the Parties is that of principal to principal. Nothing in this Agreement makes the Distributor an agent, employee, partner or joint venturer of the Company.

13.2 The Company may assign this Agreement to any person without consent. The Distributor shall not assign or sub-contract any of its obligations without the Company's prior written consent.

13.3 Any notice shall be in writing and shall be deemed delivered on the second business day after dispatch to the address stated above by speed post or courier.

13.4 This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement between the Parties and supersedes all prior communication, including any assurance given by the Company's sales personnel regarding margins or exclusivity.

SCHEDULE 1 - PRODUCTS

1. AMRUTAM Premium Tea (250 g, 500 g, 1 kg packs)
2. AMRUTAM Namkeen Range (Bhujia, Mixture, Sev; 200 g and 400 g packs)
3. AMRUTAM Fruit Squash (Mango, Orange; 750 ml bottles)
4. AMRUTAM Instant Mixes (Dhokla, Khaman, Idli; 200 g pouches)

SCHEDULE 2 - DISTRIBUTOR MARGIN

Distributor margin: 6% on Products at Price List; schemes and trade discounts to be borne by the Distributor from the said margin.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF the Parties have signed this Agreement on the date first above written.
